description: ADO-CURSOR properties versus arguments: a Recordset with ActiveConnection set by reference, Source = 'SELECT ID, S FROM T ORDER BY ID', CursorType keyset, LockType optimistic, then Open() with no arguments (State, Source, ActiveConnection, effective tuple); while open, assign CursorType, LockType, Source, ActiveConnection (a second Connection), CursorLocation and MaxRecords (each read back), a second Open, Close, then read Source, ActiveConnection and CursorType and Open() again. A second Recordset: Open with an empty-Source request, with no ActiveConnection, and with Source Missing after ActiveConnection is set. Asks which properties may change while open and what survives Close.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
